top_signals.title: Missile shelter to be built near Tokyo Station amid rising security concerns
top_signals.summary: The push to build more durable shelters comes amid North Korea's ramped-up pace of ballistic missile tests and China's growing arsenal of powerful weapons.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
